No. The text explicitly provides that, notwithstanding any other provision of the subpart, specific substitutes in specific end-uses—such as carbon dioxide in any application—are exempt from this venting prohibition and the requirements of the subpart.

source_spans.quote:
disposing of an appliance or industrial process refrigeration may knowingly vent or otherwise release into the environment any refrigerant from such appliances.
